semanticFindings: CloseAdmission rejects all new readers; already held readers may finish a SQL latch against the unchanged physical tuple. Positive execution admission is suppressed when withdrawal is detected; spent/unacknowledged latch remains retained and UNKNOWN after revoke.

A pre-close committed Backend true ACK can be delivered after CloseAdmission but before reader drain. The response-writer probe observes true. Retirement cannot complete or change physical source while this writer still holds its reader. This is not a new post-retirement grant.

Separately delayed that already committed ACK until durable retirement completed/source changed: real Receiver final proof rejects, gate inactive, ACK count zero, latch1/UNKNOWN retained. Transport ACK is never alone an output right.

Source gate fixes every official tuple field, native process identity and Guardian key/mirror. Unsupported nil/Observe-only sources and nine gate/snapshot subcases (nil gate plus eight tuple mismatches) deny installation.
Source observation/drain wait are outside SQL locks; Run-first mirror retirement precedes official revoke CAS. Partial failure remains closed; durable REVOKED readback is required after CAS conflict.

Own Backend SIGKILL before mirror retirement: fresh Registry cannot reconstruct old authority; durable latch remains and authenticated explicit CONTROL marks UNKNOWN. This is conservative reconciliation, not automatic physical recovery.
productionAssumptionAssessment: Potentially implementable only with a sole trusted Linux physical owner controlling ALL Generation/source/process/key/fence changes and publisher credentials/actual sink access, durable fail-closed restart behavior, and verified old-publisher isolation. Interface implementation or OS PID liveness alone is insufficient. Must prove those properties before enabling a real source. A physical process that can bypass this gate is outside the supported source contract and keeps layerB BLOCKED.
